title: ADNOC open to further long-term LPG deals with India, sees India among most important energy markets: Acting CEO, Marketing
description: ADNOC supplied more than 500,000 barrels of crude a day to India in 2025, “almost one in ten barrels of [India’s] crude imports”. The company is exploring opportunities with ISPRL to expand storage of crude oil, LNG and LPG, including strategic reserves
